about: From power-on with nothing saved, to the main menu, Down to Time Attack and A, then in its menu A on Start, Right to Tails in the character select and A, and A on the first act for the card; then Neo Green Hill Zone act 1 as Tails, Start and A in the pause menu for the lobby, Down twice (the second held a while to repeat) and A on the course select, B back to the character select.
